about.lead_statement: No crowded machine queues, no fake promises. Just real training, good weights, and trainers who pay attention.
body_paragraphs: Started in 2021 on Baner Road, Vajra Fitness Club was made for people who want real fitness results in Pune. Whether you want to lift weights, lose body fat, or stay active after long desk hours, our gym has everything you need.
We keep the floor clean, spacious, and well-equipped with imported barbells, bumper plates, and cardio machines. Trainers are always on the floor to correct your exercise form and prevent injuries.

testimonials.achievement: Lost 9 kg & fixed lower back pain
testimonials.quote: Sitting 10 hours at a desk in Hinjewadi ruined my posture. After 3 months of guided lifting and mobility work with Vikram sir, my lower back pain is completely gone and I have much more energy.
Super clean gym with a very respectful crowd. No loud selfie influencers or creepy stares. Trainers actually pay attention to your form instead of scrolling on phones. Best gym in West Pune.
The free weight area and turf track are top notch. Proper rubber bumper plates and squat racks. If you are serious about strength and fitness, Vajra Club is the place to be.
